download_file_with_DownloadableFile: create a DownloadableFile object with a URL and filename then call download_file to download and decompress it
download_pretrained_model: call download_pretrained_model with a model name to fetch and extract pretrained model resources from the MMF model zoo
download_from_google_drive: use download_from_google_drive to download a file from Google Drive by providing the Google Drive ID and destination path
checksum_DownloadableFile: create a DownloadableFile with a hashcode then call checksum to verify the SHA256 integrity of a downloaded file
get_image_from_url: call get_image_from_url with an image URL to fetch and return the image as a numpy array
